code_prompt_defaults.object_description: an isometric voxel maze with START, GOAL, colored checkpoint cubes, and black ladders

checkpoint_sequence_label: Walk from START to GOAL along adjacent cube tops, using black ladders to change height. Which option letter shows the checkpoint color sequence on that shortest route?
Follow adjacent cube tops and black ladders from START to GOAL. Which option gives the checkpoint color order on the shortest route?
Use the cube tops and ladders to trace the shortest START-to-GOAL route. What option letter shows the checkpoint color order?
Which displayed option lists the checkpoint colors encountered on the shortest valid route from START to GOAL?
Starting at START, follow the shortest valid route to GOAL. Which option letter matches the checkpoint color sequence?
reachable_checkpoint_count: How many colored checkpoint cubes are reachable from START by walking on adjacent cube tops and using black ladders?
Starting at START, count the colored checkpoint cubes connected by valid cube-top moves and black ladders.
How many checkpoint cubes can be reached from START without leaving the cube platforms?
Count all colored checkpoint cubes reachable from START through adjacent cube tops and ladders.
Using adjacent cube tops and black ladders only, how many colored checkpoints can START reach?
unreachable_checkpoint_label: Exactly one colored checkpoint cube cannot be reached from START by walking on adjacent cube tops and using black ladders. What is its color name?
Which colored checkpoint cube is unreachable from START through the cube tops and ladders?
Find the only checkpoint cube that is not connected to START by valid cube-top and ladder moves. What is its color name?
What color is the single unreachable checkpoint cube?
Starting from START, which checkpoint color cannot be reached through the connected cube tops and black ladders?
